name: Break-even after costs
summary: Illustrative break-even price after a flat fee on a long or short study position.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Long break-even ≈ entry + fees/shares. Short ≈ entry − fees/shares. Fees are a number you supply; FRIDAY does not read a broker schedule.
